'''Sazat''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the archive analyst on the ''[[Cryptic Warning]]''. During a mission, Sazat presented his findings of the diplomatic meeting on the planet, which was also attended by [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]].
